final_text:
I added `latestForCustomer(String customerId)` to `OrderFacade`. It returns `Optional<OrderSummary>`, so an empty result means the customer has no orders. The test suite passes.

- **`OrderFacade`**: new method with a Javadoc note that it returns empty when there are no orders.
- **`OrderRepository`**: new `latestForCustomer` that filters by customer and takes the maximum `placedAt`.
- **`OrderService`**: implements the method as a read-only transaction and maps the result to `OrderSummary`. I moved the summary mapping into a private helper that `summary(...)` now also uses.
- **`ShopFlowTest`**: two new tests. One checks that the order with the latest `placedAt` is returned, even when it was not the last one placed. The other checks that a customer with no orders gets an empty result.
